_readme: Search profile for tools/scrape_sweep.py. Copy this file to job_scraper/sweep_profile.json and adapt it;
/setup writes it from the candidate profile. job_scraper/ is gitignored, so the copy stays private.
areas: on-site/hybrid search areas (portal location name, radius in km, LinkedIn location string).
freehire_cities: freehire only matches exact city names, so list the places inside your areas.
remote: also sweep fully remote roles in Germany.
arbeitsagentur_fields: occupational fields (Berufsfelder) of the Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit to sweep.
xing_keywords / linkedin_remote_keywords: XING has no location-only sweep and LinkedIn remote caps at 1,000
results, so both search per keyword. Add keywords until a new one finds (almost) nothing the others missed.
relevant / excluded / core: title regexes (case-insensitive). relevant is the wide net, excluded always drops,
core marks the titles that get the fit check; the rest of relevant is only skimmed.
score: [regex, points] pairs summed over the title to order candidates; negative points push titles down.
preferred_location: optional regex on the posting's location that adds bonus points (empty = off).
auto_read: minimum score for reading a core posting in full automatically, per area (corridor) or remote.
auto_read_max: at most this many postings are read in full automatically per sweep (0 = no cap). Each read costs Claude quota (~1,500 tokens); raise it on a bigger plan.
employer_list: optional path (repo-relative) to a markdown ranking table of wished-for employers.
salary_floor: optional yearly gross minimum; tools/salary_band.py never suggests a figure below it (0 = none).
